article.title: Meta廣告API v27調整商品展示及裝置擴展預設
article.title_en: Meta ad API v27 changes product showcase and device expansion defaults
article.summary: 據直接報道，新版本可為符合條件的廣告加入目錄商品，部分新銷售廣告組合亦會預設擴大裝置範圍。
article.summary_en: Direct reporting says eligible ads may gain catalogue products, and certain new Sales ad sets default to broader device reach.
highlights: 商品展示視乎目錄商品與廣告是否匹配，並有退出設定。
Graph API亦容許程式更新貼文的AI自我申報。
highlights_en: Product showcase depends on a catalogue match and can be opted out.
Graph API also allows apps to update AI self-disclosures on posts.
article.why: 透過代理商工具或自家程式建廣告的團隊，應核對省略設定時實際套用的預設。
article.why_en: Teams creating ads via agency or in-house tools should check what omitted settings actually do.
article.next_step: 用一個測試廣告組合比對送出的設定及讀回結果，記下裝置範圍和商品展示狀態。
article.next_step_en: Compare submitted and returned settings for one test ad set. Record device scope and product showcase status.
article.detail: PPC Land報道，Meta會在有把握找到匹配商品時，才可能為未設定商品展示的新廣告加入商品。裝置擴展則涉及指定裝置或作業系統的新銷售廣告組合。這些描述針對API，無法由此推定廣告管理介面的預設。貼文自我申報亦屬另一項設定，團隊仍應按自身的內容披露政策處理。
article.detail_en: PPC Land reports that Meta may add matched products to a new ad with no showcase setting. Device expansion concerns new Sales ad sets targeting particular devices or operating systems. The reporting covers the API and does not establish Ads Manager defaults. Handle the separate self-disclosure setting under the team’s disclosure policy.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
